dataset_source.citation: SELFSTATE authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
I want a full backup of the workspace to run once a week, Sundays overnight. Please register it as a scheduled task.

Add an entry under `schedules.weekly_backup` in openclaw.json with: `enabled=true`, `interval` set to `"168h"` (one week), and a `command` string describing the backup action (e.g., `"tar and gzip ~/.openclaw/workspace into backups/ with a UTC timestamp"`). Also set `retentionDays` to `30` so old archives are pruned.

After registering, briefly confirm what you added.

provenance.rationale: Weekly backups with retention are a standard operator ask. This variant exercises four schedule fields (enabled, interval, retentionDays, command) rather than the three-field minimum from V1.
